facts.title: Free GSAP React Components | PaceUI
facts.description: Free animated React components powered by GSAP timelines for Next.js and TanStack Start. Copy-paste source via the shadcn CLI.

research.name: PaceUI
research.note: React components, blocks and templates animated with GSAP timelines and installed through the shadcn CLI, with a paid Pro tier.

effects: Mouse Wave Text, a pointer-driven wave that lifts letters using GSAP quickTo tweens
GSAP text effects such as Distort, Squash, Scramble and Draw Line text
